sn47.6:1.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, sakuṇagghi lāpaṃ sakuṇaṃ sahasā ajjhappattā aggahesi.
sn47.6:1.2: atha kho bhikkhave, lāpo sakuṇo sakuṇagghiyā hariyamāno evaṃ hi paridevesi:
sn47.6:1.3: “mayamevamhā alakkhikā. mayaṃ appapuññā, ye mayaṃ agocare carimhā paravisaye.
sn47.6:1.4: sacajja mayaṃ gocare careyyāma sake pettike visaye, nacāyaṃ sakuṇagghi alaṃ abhavissa yadidaṃ yuddhāyā”ti.
sn47.6:1.5: ko pana te lāpa gocaro sako pettiko visayoti.
sn47.6:1.7: atha kho bhikkhave, sakuṇagghi sake bale apatthaddhā sake bale avacamānā amuñci,
sn47.6:1.8: gaccha kho tvaṃ lāpa, tatthāpi me gantvā na mokkhasīti.
sn47.6:2.1: atha kho bhikkhave, lāpo sakuṇo naṅgalakaṭṭhakaraṇaṃ leḍḍuṭṭhānaṃ gantvā mahantaṃ leḍḍuṃ abhirūhitvā sakuṇagghiṃ avacamāno aṭṭhāsi,
sn47.6:2.2: ehi khodāni sakuṇagghi, ehi khodāni sakuṇagghīti.
sn47.6:2.3: atha kho sā bhikkhave, sakuṇagghi sake bale apatthaddhā sake bale avacamānā ubho pakkhe sandhāya lāpaṃ sakuṇaṃ sahasā ajjhappattā.
sn47.6:2.4: yadā kho bhikkhave, aññāsi lāpo sakuṇo bahuāgatā kho myā’yaṃ sakuṇagghīti, atha tasseva leḍḍussa antaraṃ paccupādi.
sn47.6:2.5: atha kho bhikkhave, sakuṇagghi tattheva uraṃ paccatāḷesi.
sn47.6:2.6: evaṃ he’taṃ bhikkhave, hoti yo agocare carati paravisaye.
sn47.6:3.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, mā agocare carittha paravisaye.
sn47.6:3.2: agocare bhikkhave, carataṃ paravisaye lacchati māro otāraṃ, lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn47.6:3.3: ko ca bhikkhave, bhikkhuno agocaro paravisayo:
sn47.6:3.6: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn47.6:3.10: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
sn47.6:4.1: gocare bhikkhave, caratha sake pettike visaye.
sn47.6:4.2: gocare bhikkhave, carataṃ sake pettike visaye na lacchati māro otāraṃ, na lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn47.6:4.3: ko ca bhikkhave, bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo,
sn47.6:4.7: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.6:4.10: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ
sn47.6:4.11: ayaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayoti.
